name: 三味混合胶囊咖啡礼盒款

styleLock.direction: premium coffee-capsule gift-set system: pure-white studio infographics alternating with warm documentary photography, certifications only from verified facts
styleLock.temperature: dual zones: neutral white for infographics, warm 3200-3800K for documentary scenes
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF studio grounds with reflective floor for infographics; off-white #F1EDE6 text panels; natural materials (burlap, rainforest, kitchen) for documentary scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft top plus frontal large softbox with gentle contact shadows and floor reflections for studio; warm golden side-backlight for documentary; natural misty light for aerials
styleLock.surfaceSystem: reflective white plinth for studio shots, matte off-white paper panels, glassware with thick hazel crema, burlap and wood in scenes
styleLock.typography: thin-weight letterspaced uppercase headlines in black, bold oversized key numbers, regular body with airy leading
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.5px line-stroke circular icons for sizes and actions; square-step intensity gauges; gold line-drawn leaf motif for circularity; neutral rounded frames
styleLock.presentationRules: infographics follow title-graphic-footnote three bands; documentary shots use one-third photo to two-thirds off-white panel split; a three-flavor color code (gold #C98F4E, blue #1B6E93, olive #4A6741) runs across capsules, bands and gauges; circular crop as signature composition; every finished cup shows thick crema
noDrift: no brand wordmarks or capsule-face engravings
no machine hero shots or subscription messaging
no extra hues outside the three-flavor code
no invented farmer counts or impact numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: a premium coffee-capsule gift-set system built on two alternating layers. Layer one is seamless pure-white #FFFFFF studio infographics under soft top light with gentle contact shadows and floor reflections, thin-weight letterspaced uppercase headlines with bold key numbers, 1.5px line-stroke icons and square-step intensity gauges. Layer two is warm documentary photography - golden backlit hands sifting beans, faceless farmers among red cherries, misty rainforest aerials, kitchen recycling moments - always framed as one-third photo to two-thirds off-white #F1EDE6 text-panel split at 3200-3800K. A three-flavor color code (espresso gold #C98F4E, lake blue #1B6E93, olive green #4A6741) runs across capsules, bands and gauges on a charcoal #1A1A1A and white base. Circularity uses a gold line-drawn leaf motif over scattered grounds; every finished cup shows thick hazel crema; certifications and impact claims appear only when verified. No brand wordmarks, no machine hero shots, no subscription messaging, no third-party logos, no identifiable faces.

shots.props: three capsules (gold, olive, blue) lined up in front of the box
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on with a slight downward tilt: the matte black gift box centered, its top edge visible, three capsules in gold #C98F4E, olive #4A6741 and blue #1B6E93 lined up along the front edge, three small colored count strips printed on the box face. Large top and frontal softbox, soft floor shadow on pure white #FFFFFF. Box occupies 70%. Count strips stay as neutral unlabeled bars. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand wordmarks or logos, no readable flavor names, no watermark, no extra props, no certification prints, no cut-off edges.
